description.value: A free community museum exploring the history of Comox from its earliest days to the present, including a K'omox First Nation component and a dedicated 102nd Battalion WWI exhibit. The museum also houses local archives and a small shop selling books, cards, and gifts. A compact cultural stop right on Comox Avenue for cyclists passing through town.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 32m; bollard (4 spaces) at 47m; rack (4 spaces) at 67m; bollard (2 spaces) at 74m; rack (9 spaces) at 76m. Total: 23 spaces.

No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for any bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other amenities — all set to null.
